headline: NCLT approves amalgamation of ARCL, MCL and JRDL into JSW Steel Limited
sum: NCLT has issued a final order approving the scheme of amalgamation of three JSW Group subsidiaries (ARCL, MCL, JRDL) into JSW Steel Limited. The ruling consolidates the group's structural entities under the flagship steel company.
detail: The National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT) has issued a final merger order under the Companies Act, 2013 approving the amalgamation of Arcelor Mittal Construction Limited (ARCL), Monnet Cement Limited (MCL), and JSW Realty Development Limited (JRDL) into JSW Steel Limited. The scheme consolidates multiple group entities (spanning construction, cement and real estate) into the listed parent. As a composite scheme involving three separate merging entities, this required NCLT sanction under s.230 et seq. The final order was received on 3 July 2026, following shareholder and creditor approval processes.
